concept: JACCL RDMA completion status checking and silent corruption
summary: zcbenz's closing reason: it is easier for maintainers to write and verify such changes themselves than to review contributor PRs over several rounds

facts.text: zcbenz's closing reason: it is easier for maintainers to write and verify such changes themselves than to review contributor PRs over several rounds
angeloskath measured about 10% slowdown (about 1 us) on 16 KB 4-way all-reduce and held the PR for a JACCL refactor and optimisation pass, noting the team treats Thunderbolt as a reliable channel
The rebased PR changed 3 files (+61 lines) and added 4 check sites in mesh_impl.h and 5 in ring_impl.h
The first commit message cites IBV_WC_RETRY_EXC_ERR as an example of an RDMA transport error that was silently ignored
The original PR also made Connection::poll() and the free poll() throw on a negative ibv_poll_cq return
The PR author tested 256, 512, 5478+433 and 8490+512 token generations on the 612 GB model with zero RDMA errors after the fix, and saw no regression on models under 10 GB per rank
The PR author states small models are unaffected because their RDMA operations always succeed, so the bug is latent
After a peer is SIGKILLed, ibv_poll_cq returned 0 about 2.64 billion times, never negative, never a bad wc.status, so status checking cannot detect peer loss

Related exo report: macOS 26.3.1 4x M3 Ultra clusters hit "[jaccl] Recv failed with errno=2", errno=60 and "Changing queue pair to RTR failed with errno 22"; the reporter says the #3451 race fix removed the post-kill RTR failures

Issue #3467 root cause: after the #3412 refactor Connection::info() only accepts IPv4-mapped GIDs (::ffff:x.x.x.x) but Apple Thunderbolt RDMA can expose only link-local fe80:: GIDs, leaving the GID uninitialised and giving RTR errno 22
